transport.title: Transport
transport.heading: YOUR GOODS, OUR PRIORITY
transport.description: KAMLOG provides land freight transport from ports, warehouses and loading points across the Central Africa sub-region. Our modern fleet and experienced drivers guarantee reliability and punctuality.

services.title: Our Services
services.item1: Transport of 20' and 40' containers (full or empty)
services.item3: Transport of sensitive or high-value goods

benefits.title: Client Benefits
benefits.item1: Qualified drivers trained in safety standards

containers.title: Container Yard
containers.heading: A SAFE SOLUTION FOR YOUR CONTAINERS
containers.description: KAMLOG provides a modern and secure container yard for temporary storage of your empty or full containers. Located near the ports of Douala and Kribi, our infrastructure allows flexible and efficient management.

customs.title: Customs Transit & Import / Export
customs.heading: WE SIMPLIFY YOUR FORMALITIES, YOU SAVE TIME
customs.description: KAMLOG supports its clients in all import and export transit procedures, guaranteeing regulatory compliance, time savings and cost control. Thanks to our expertise and customs network, we ensure smooth management of your files.

import.title: Import
import.item1: Collection of goods at the port or airport
import.item3: Customs clearance at Douala or Kribi port
import.item4: Management of health or technical procedures (MINCOMMERCE, MINDAF...)
import.item8: Home delivery in Douala or hinterland

export.title: Export
export.item1: Collection of goods from warehouse or factory
export.item2: Container stuffing at our premises or client site
export.item3: Establishment of export documents (BAE, BL, invoice...)

warehouse.title: WAREHOUSING & INVENTORY MANAGEMENT
warehouse.heading: YOUR GOODS SAFE, UNDER PERMANENT CONTROL
warehouse.description: KAMLOG has secure warehousing facilities adapted to different types of goods: industrial products, agricultural equipment, consumer goods, and more.

features.item1: Bonded warehouse (fictitious warehouse) allowing deferral of duties and taxes
features.item2: Area: 5,000 m² covered + 22,000 m² outdoor for containers
features.item7: Dedicated space for dangerous goods storage (with permits)
features.item8: Possibility of grouping, ungrouping and packaging

handling.title: PORT HANDLING & BERTHING
handling.heading: PROFESSIONAL HANDLING AT THE HEART OF THE PORT
handling.description: KAMLOG handles goods at the Autonomous Port of Douala (Quay 3) as well as at Kribi Port. Our qualified teams and high-performance equipment guarantee fast, secure and compliant handling.

services.title: Our Services
services.item3: Handling of heavy and bulky packages
services.item4: Transfer of goods from quayside to warehouses or storage areas

benefits.title: Client Benefits
benefits.item1: Speed and efficiency (reduction of immobilization times)
benefits.item2: Availability of high-performance equipment (cranes, forklifts, tractors...)
